final_answer:
The CitiLink-Summ dataset provides a new corpus of European Portuguese municipal meeting minutes with 100 documents and 2,322 manually hand-written summaries. The research focuses on summarizing discussion subjects in municipal meeting minutes, which are formal records documenting the discussions and decisions of local government. The dataset is used to establish baseline results for automatic summarization in this domain, employing state-of-the-art generative models and large language models.
